response.hazard_agreement_note: Share of the real traverse length our map does NOT class as no-go for rover_scout (caution >= 15 deg, no-go >= 20 deg, slope on the 2 m grid). Higher supports the hazard map.
response.route_realism_note: Planned vs actually driven length between consecutive real waypoints (100-1500 m drives, spread over the mission; actual = rover odometry where available). Ratios below 1 mean our planner found a shorter path than the rover drove, often because real drives detour for science, rocks below DEM resolution, and odometry includes wheel slip.
